title: Harvest Decision, Segregation, and Trim Workbook
purpose: Provide traceable records for harvest maturity, harvest-unit selection, sanitation and segregation, trim timing, and initial drying-process characterization.

sections.title: Harvest Maturity Decision
sections.decisionPrompt: Do the combined biological, analytical, disease, weather, and capacity signals support harvest now?

sections.title: Whole-Plant vs Branch Harvest Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Which harvest-unit method produced the best balance of traceability, handling, drying uniformity, and quality?

sections.title: Harvest Sanitation and Batch Segregation Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Can every harvested unit be traced through each transfer without identity or sanitation ambiguity?

sections.title: Wet vs Dry Trim Comparison
sections.decisionPrompt: Which trimming approach performs better under matched batch conditions without confounding drying or handling differences?

sections.title: Drying Heat and Mass Transfer Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does the drying profile show stable moisture removal without spatial stalls, condensation, or over-drying?

qualityRules: Use representative sample positions and retain raw observations.
Keep harvest and drying identities linked across transfers.
Do not use one visual maturity cue as the sole release basis.
Define trimming and harvest-unit methods precisely before comparing outcomes.
